title: Portfolio
text:
Teenagers Who Never Held the Vote Declined as Much as Those Who Lost It
Why did German teenagers feel less heard after losing voting eligibility: because they lost a right, or because an election excluded them?
I reanalyse a published panel survey from Schleswig-Holstein using difference-in-differences in R. External efficacy fell by similar amounts among teenagers who lost the vote and those who had never been eligible. The comparison cannot isolate an additional withdrawal effect, and age differences limit causal interpretation.
Read the paper View presentation
Independent research. The paper includes the methods, commented code, results, references, and appendix.
